title: Severe bleeding
plain: Heavy bleeding that does not stop. Firm pressure stops most bleeding.

doNotGive.reason: Aspirin and ibuprofen make bleeding worse

steps.text: Press hard on the wound with a clean dressing. Keep pressing; don't lift it to look.
Lie down and raise the bleeding part above your heart.

steps.question: Has the bleeding stopped or slowed a lot?

steps.text: Add more dressings and press harder. On an arm or leg: use the tourniquet from the kit.
Bandage it firmly. Fingers or toes should stay warm and pink.

escalation: Not controlled after 30 minutes, or you feel faint, cold or confused: lie flat, keep pressing and follow EMG-SEVERE-BLEEDING. The crew and Earth were alerted when you started.
